report_name: EU Academy Data Leak Caused by 'AI-Assisted' Cyberattack

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The EU Academy, a public-facing online learning platform, was breached to gain initial access, leading to the exfiltration of user data.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: User data, specifically names and email addresses, was collected from the EU Academy platform's systems during the breach.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Personal data consisting of names and email addresses was exfiltrated from the compromised EU Academy platform.

malware.name: ARTEX
malware.description: A malicious AI penetration testing tool suspected to have been used to automate the attack on the EU Academy platform, including vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and data exfiltration.

identities.name: European Commission
identities.description: The parent organization of the EU Academy, which confirmed the AI-assisted cyberattack and resulting data breach.

identities.name: EU Academy
identities.description: The online learning platform operated by the European Commission that was the direct target of the cyberattack, resulting in a data breach of user information.

identities.name: EU Academy users (non-EU institutions)
identities.description: The group of users whose personal data (names and email addresses) was exposed in the data breach.

indicators.name: Suspicious GraphQL Introspection Query
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious GraphQL Introspection Query
id: 2b9a8f7e-1c3d-4b5a-9e8f-7a6b5c4d3e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects GraphQL introspection queries which can be used by attackers to discover the API schema for data exfiltration, as suggested in hunting hints for AI-assisted attacks.
references:
  - https://www.wsls.com/tech/2026/11/23/european-commission-warns-eu-academy-users-of-data-leak-after-ai-driven-cyberattack/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-26
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/api/graphql'
      - '/graphql'
    c-uri-query|contains:
      - 'query IntrospectionQuery'
      - '__schema'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects GraphQL introspection queries which can be used by attackers to discover the API schema for data exfiltration. This was suggested as a hunting hint for detecting AI-powered tools.
